sources.title: CohereLabs/cohere-transcribe-03-2026 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Cohere Transcribe demonstrates best-in-class transcription accuracy in 14 languages. As a dedicated speech recognition model, it is also efficient, benefitting from a real-time factor up to three times faster than that of other, dedicated ASR models in the same size range.
